fix.text: A North London grime MC, rapper and producer of Nigerian heritage who started as a DJ in the Meridian Crew and, with his brother Jme, founded Boy Better Know. In 2009 he was convicted of common assault, and in 2016 he pleaded guilty in Melbourne to recklessly causing injury (no conviction was recorded); that year he was refused a US visa over his criminal record.

fix.text: A rapper from Wembley's Chalkhill Estate, best known for '9 to 5' and 'Love Me or Hate Me'. She was inspired to MC after hearing Ms. Dynamite and was signed to Def Jam by Jay-Z in 2005. In 2009 she was arrested in Brisbane for assault and drunk and disorderly behaviour after spitting on a nightclub bouncer, and was fined.
